# Generated by tools/build_zhx_guest_school.py. Do not hand-edit.

zhx_guest_school_clear_pending = {
    clr_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_pending_ru
    clr_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_pending_fa
    clr_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_pending_mo
    clr_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_pending_dao
    clr_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_pending_bing
    clr_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_pending_zongheng
}

zhx_guest_school_clear_source_link = {
    every_country = {
        limit = {
            has_opinion_modifier = {
                who = ROOT
                modifier = zhx_opinion_guest_school_source_link
            }
        }
        remove_opinion = {
            who = ROOT
            modifier = zhx_opinion_guest_school_source_link
        }
    }
}

# Generation flags deliberately survive cleanup. A subsequent contract
# toggles A/B so callbacks from an expelled earlier term cannot hit it.
zhx_guest_school_clear_contract_state = {
    remove_country_modifier = zhx_ru_invited_scholar_modifier
    remove_country_modifier = zhx_fa_invited_scholar_modifier
    remove_country_modifier = zhx_mo_invited_scholar_modifier
    remove_country_modifier = zhx_dao_invited_scholar_modifier
    remove_country_modifier = zhx_bing_invited_scholar_modifier
    remove_country_modifier = zhx_zongheng_invited_scholar_modifier
    remove_country_modifier = zhx_guest_school_adjustment
    remove_country_modifier = has_invited_scholar_recently
    clr_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_active
    clr_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_ru
    clr_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_fa
    clr_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_mo
    clr_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_dao
    clr_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_bing
    clr_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_zongheng
    zhx_guest_school_clear_pending = yes
    zhx_guest_school_clear_source_link = yes
}

zhx_guest_school_clear_silently = {
    zhx_guest_school_clear_contract_state = yes
}

zhx_guest_school_toggle_generation_and_schedule = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_generation_a }
        clr_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_generation_a
        set_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_generation_b
        country_event = { id = zhx_guest_school.21 days = 6935 }
        country_event = { id = zhx_guest_school.31 days = 7300 }
    }
    else = {
        clr_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_generation_b
        set_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_generation_a
        country_event = { id = zhx_guest_school.20 days = 6935 }
        country_event = { id = zhx_guest_school.30 days = 7300 }
    }
}

zhx_guest_school_pay_contract_cost = {
    add_dip_power = -75
    add_years_of_income = -0.5
}

zhx_guest_school_mark_pending_source = {
    zhx_guest_school_clear_source_link = yes
    event_target:zhx_guest_school_pending_source = {
        add_opinion = {
            who = ROOT
            modifier = zhx_opinion_guest_school_source_link
            years = 21
        }
    }
}

zhx_guest_school_begin_ru = {
    if = {
        limit = { zhx_guest_school_pending_ru_is_valid = yes }
        zhx_guest_school_pay_contract_cost = yes
        zhx_guest_school_mark_pending_source = yes
        set_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_active
        set_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_ru
        add_country_modifier = { name = zhx_ru_invited_scholar_modifier duration = 7300 }
        add_country_modifier = {
            name = zhx_guest_school_adjustment
            duration = 1825
        }
        zhx_guest_school_toggle_generation_and_schedule = yes
        zhx_guest_school_clear_pending = yes
        zhx_refresh_academy_country_effects = yes
    }
}

zhx_guest_school_pick_ru_renewal_source = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            any_country = {
                zhx_guest_school_source_is_eligible_ru = yes
                has_opinion_modifier = {
                    who = ROOT
                    modifier = zhx_opinion_guest_school_source_link
                }
            }
        }
        random_country = {
            limit = {
                zhx_guest_school_source_is_eligible_ru = yes
                has_opinion_modifier = {
                    who = ROOT
                    modifier = zhx_opinion_guest_school_source_link
                }
            }
            save_event_target_as = zhx_guest_school_renewal_source
        }
    }
    else = {
        random_country = {
            limit = { zhx_guest_school_source_is_eligible_ru = yes }
            save_event_target_as = zhx_guest_school_renewal_source
        }
    }
}

zhx_guest_school_renew_ru = {
    if = {
        limit = { zhx_guest_school_has_valid_ru_renewal_source = yes }
        zhx_guest_school_pick_ru_renewal_source = yes
        zhx_guest_school_pay_contract_cost = yes
        zhx_guest_school_clear_source_link = yes
        event_target:zhx_guest_school_renewal_source = {
            add_opinion = {
                who = ROOT
                modifier = zhx_opinion_guest_school_source_link
                years = 21
            }
        }
        clr_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_active
        set_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_active
        remove_country_modifier = zhx_ru_invited_scholar_modifier
        add_country_modifier = { name = zhx_ru_invited_scholar_modifier duration = 7300 }
        remove_country_modifier = zhx_guest_school_adjustment
        zhx_guest_school_toggle_generation_and_schedule = yes
        zhx_refresh_academy_country_effects = yes
    }
}

zhx_guest_school_renew_current = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_ru }
        zhx_guest_school_renew_ru = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_fa }
        zhx_guest_school_renew_fa = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_mo }
        zhx_guest_school_renew_mo = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_dao }
        zhx_guest_school_renew_dao = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_bing }
        zhx_guest_school_renew_bing = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_zongheng }
        zhx_guest_school_renew_zongheng = yes
    }
}

zhx_guest_school_honour_source = {
    every_country = {
        limit = {
            has_opinion_modifier = {
                who = ROOT
                modifier = zhx_opinion_guest_school_source_link
            }
        }
        add_opinion = { who = ROOT modifier = zhx_opinion_guest_school_honoured }
    }
}

zhx_guest_school_close_normally = {
    zhx_guest_school_honour_source = yes
    zhx_guest_school_clear_contract_state = yes
    zhx_refresh_academy_country_effects = yes
    zhx_doctrine_reform_reconcile = yes
}

zhx_guest_school_expel_reaction_ru = {
    every_country = {
        limit = {
            exists = yes
            NOT = { tag = ROOT }
            zhx_is_lijiao_country = yes
            has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_ru
            NOT = {
                has_opinion_modifier = {
                    who = ROOT
                    modifier = zhx_opinion_guest_school_source_link
                }
            }
        }
        add_opinion = {
            who = ROOT
            modifier = zhx_opinion_guest_school_expelled_school
        }
    }
}

            modifier = zhx_opinion_guest_school_expelled_school
        }
    }
}

zhx_guest_school_expel_current = {
    if = {
        limit = { zhx_guest_school_has_active_contract = yes }
        if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_ru }
            zhx_guest_school_expel_reaction_ru = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_fa }
            zhx_guest_school_expel_reaction_fa = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_mo }
            zhx_guest_school_expel_reaction_mo = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_dao }
            zhx_guest_school_expel_reaction_dao = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_bing }
            zhx_guest_school_expel_reaction_bing = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = zhx_guest_school_contract_zongheng }
            zhx_guest_school_expel_reaction_zongheng = yes
        }
        every_country = {
            limit = {
                has_opinion_modifier = {
                    who = ROOT
                    modifier = zhx_opinion_guest_school_source_link
                }
            }
            add_opinion = {
                who = ROOT
                modifier = zhx_opinion_guest_school_expelled_source
            }
        }
        add_stability = -1
        add_country_modifier = {
            name = zhx_guest_school_dishonour
            duration = 3650
        }
        zhx_guest_school_clear_contract_state = yes
        zhx_refresh_academy_country_effects = yes
        zhx_doctrine_reform_reconcile = yes
    }
}

zhx_guest_school_cache_current_source = {
    random_country = {
        limit = {
            has_opinion_modifier = {
                who = ROOT
                modifier = zhx_opinion_guest_school_source_link
            }
        }
        save_event_target_as = zhx_guest_school_current_source
    }
}
